text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I want to win the race in Dubai"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the Tiara route, Vivlos trained hard
to move forward toward her next dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the start of a certain winter filled with such fulfillment...
"That moment" inevitably arrived.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...――
*wheeze*, *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Vivlos collapsed out of nowhere,
so we rushed her straight to the hospital.
The results of her examination were...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "Now that the tension of the Tiara route has snapped, all the strain from pushing herself so hard must have caught up with her at once."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It probably won't be much of an issue for domestic training and races, but...
you're aiming for an overseas expedition, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I really want to go to Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It's probably best to pass on it this time.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
An overseas campaign is completely different from daily life.
Because the environment changes significantly, a tough mind and body capable of enduring it are required.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Take Hokko Tarumae, for example.
She fell ill during an unfamiliar overseas campaign
and was subsequently forced into a long-term hiatus.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Even the strongest Umamusume suffer severe weight loss during long travels.
Regrettably, it is a common occurrence.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Right now, at least physically...
I don't believe Verxina-san can withstand a harsh overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, thinking of the future...
it would be best to step back this time and make recovering your health the top priority.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
If she had rested for about half a year
the moment she noticed something was off,
things might have turned out differently, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: How about doing your best without pushing too hard... just like before the Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then, surely we will again—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'm sorry.
It's not at that kind of level anymore, you know?"
choice_data_list: ...Let's find out at the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Depending on her performance in the Nakayama Kinen, we might be able to judge whether she can withstand a grueling overseas campaign.
choice_data_list: Let's take it one step at a time and listen to your body again, alright?
Let's take it one step at a time and listen to your body again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...
...You already know, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...I ended up pushing you too hard, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I stole away your most cherished dream.
...I'm a failure as an older sister.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not your fault, Big Sis!
It's because I was being selfish...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: ...For now, shall we head back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos,
shall we link arms?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine.
I can walk on my own...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Vivlos began training while keeping a close eye on her condition, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She wasn't the only one
harboring feelings of frustration."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Damn it, nothing's changing...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though my little sister pulled off results like that.
I'm just..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand recently ran in a GⅠ and managed to
place on the board... but she must be frustrated
with her inability to break through to the top.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi...
choice_data_list: (I want to let her take a breather)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, a heavy atmosphere hangs over her and everyone around her.
I want to at least do something to brighten her mood."
choice_data_list: (If it's Vivlos, it's gotta be—that, right?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah!
Suuuuper celeb!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On our next day off, where I brought Vivlos and the others
was a daytime cruise party."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For the sake of celeb-loving Vibrious, I pulled some strings with Chairwoman Akikawa and managed to score some invitation tickets.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! There's a concession stand too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, isn't that charm super cute?
Let's get matching ones, Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I won't...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Waaah♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Was it really alright
for us to join you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Enjoy it, huh?
choice_data_list: You like this kind of thing, don't you?
You like this sort of thing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Cheval, you really love the sea and ships, don't you?
When was that again...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She was so desperate to ride this super
wobbly-looking water taxi—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's from when we went to Dubai!
Cheval was in unusually high spirits, and Mom and Dad were so happy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true, isn't it.
...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: It'll be a fun memory, right?
It'll be a fun memory, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it was so much fun.
That's why I came to love Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because I was together
with my beloved family.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: If it was for the sake of my beloved family, then even if it's lonely, I have no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis!
I...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Running in the same race as you, big sis,
and having so many people cheer for us...
It was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Big Sis?
Weren't you happy?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I was so happy.
Truly."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right?
So... this was the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"You only get one chance at the Tiara route.
I'm so, sooo glad I ran back then!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Getting to run and see Big Sis's smile! I was so, soo... happy.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like the mood has lightened a bit for both Vivlos and Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's so dazzling.
And yet, I...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chi!
I'm going to do my absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"At the Nakayama Kinen,
I'll prove that I'm ready to go to Dubai!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It'll work out somehow, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So Cheval-chi, you too—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Things won't just
work out somehow.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: No, that was my...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Vivlos.
Let's leave them be for a moment."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She probably wants to be alone right now.
...Should I go grab some drinks?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm coming too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainie!
Won't you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay.
I understand Cheval-chi, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm still concerned about Cheval Grand, but...
for now, it seems Vivlos has resolved her feelings
heading into the Nakayama Kinen.
